android.desc:
Simple and elegant streaming radio app for SomaFM.

* Listen to all SomaFM stations
* See a beautiful visualization (remember WinAmp?)
* Play everywhere: Chromecast, Bluetooth, Auto, XR
* Sort stations by Popularity, Title, Genre
* Save your favorite stations, filter by favorites
* See currently playing track. Click it to see that track in your second favorite music app

Channels: Beat Blender, Black Rock FM, Boot Liquor, Bossa Beyond, Chillits Radio, Covers, DEF CON Radio, Deep Space One, Digitalis, Doomed, Drone Zone, Dub Step Beyond, Fluid, Folk Forward, Groove Salad, Groove Salad Classic, Heavyweight Reggae, Illinois Street Lounge, Indie Pop Rocks!, Left Coast 70s, Lush, Metal Detector, Mission Control, PopTron, SF 10-33, SF Police Scanner, SF in SF, Secret Agent, Seven Inch Soul, SomaFM Live, SomaFM Specials, Sonic Universe, Space Station Soma, Suburbs of Goa, Synphaera Radio, The Dark Zone, The In-Sound, The Trip, ThistleRadio, Tiki Time, Underground 80s, Vaporwaves, cliqhop idm, n5MD Radio
